summary: Plumas NF lookout in Lassen County, newest in 1956, under budget threat in 1971; the Forest Lookouts page marks it Removed with no date, while both FFLA lists say Standing.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts marks it Removed, with no date or source; both FFLA lists say Standing (ground-level lookout, no register). Current condition unconfirmed.

events.note: Raymond Scott of Susanville manned the lookout, described as the newest addition to the Plumas National Forest system (Reno Evening Gazette, July 31, 1956)
Budget cuts might discontinue fire lookout service on Seven Lakes (Portola Reporter item, April 29, 1971); a preliminary review, not a closure notice

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both FFLA lists read Standing for Seven Lakes Mountain as a ground-level lookout with no register. The only source that disagrees is the Forest Lookouts Removed label, which gives no date or source.

notes_for_editor: Status: the Forest Lookouts page labels it Removed with no date or source; both FFLA lists say Standing, Ground type, no register. The 1971 item is a warning about budget cuts, not a closure. An earlier note that the statewide list showed an enclosed tower with NHLR US 1382, CA 205 was wrong: that number belongs to Scott Bar Mountain (Siskiyou). One web search found nothing about a removal or this lookout. No staffing after 1956 found. No photos. Do not encourage climbing.
